item.title: Flat racing’s biggest draw Bow Echo in shock retirement after training injury
item.summary: Unbeaten colt’s career cut short after six races Boughey: ‘He has given us some extraordinary days’ The trainer George Boughey announced on Tuesday the shock retirement of his superstar colt Bow Echo because of injury. The three‑year-old had cemented his reputation as the outstanding miler in Europe at the Glorious Goodwood meeting two weeks ago, defying the odds by coming from what looked an impossible position a furlong out to win the Sussex Stakes .
